clothing-men-shirts.name: Slim Fit Checked Shirt
clothing-men-shirts.description: Made from soft cotton with a small black and blue check. It has a slim cut, a button-down collar and a curved hem for office or weekend wear.

reviews.body: Fits well across the shoulders and the check looks sharp. Cotton feels soft even after two washes.
Good shirt for the price. The sleeves are a little long for me but the rest is fine.

clothing-men-shirts.name: Plain White Formal Shirt
clothing-men-shirts.description: A cotton-blend shirt in plain white with a spread collar and full sleeves. The regular fit gives room to move and works well under a blazer.

reviews.body: Does not go see-through and the collar stays flat all day. Arrived neatly folded in a clear pack.
Nice crisp look for meetings. Needs a quick iron after washing, which is expected.

clothing-men-shirts.name: Linen Blend Casual Shirt
clothing-men-shirts.description: Cut from a linen and cotton blend in sand beige with a relaxed fit. The light weave suits warm weather and can be worn untucked.

reviews.body: Very airy in summer heat. The crumpled look is part of the style and I like it.
Fabric is good but it creases badly. Size ran slightly large, so order one down.

clothing-men-shirts.name: Striped Oxford Shirt
clothing-men-shirts.description: Woven in a thick oxford cotton with thin blue and white vertical stripes. It has a chest pocket and a regular fit with a sturdy collar.

reviews.body: Thick fabric feels durable and the stripes are even. Stitching on the pocket is neat.
Bought two for work and both fit the same. Delivery came a day early.

clothing-men-shirts.name: Denim Western Shirt
clothing-men-shirts.description: A mid-blue denim shirt with snap buttons and two flap pockets. The fabric is medium weight and the fit is straight through the body.

reviews.body: Looks great over a plain tee. Snap buttons are firm and have not loosened.
Denim is stiff at first but softens after a wash. Colour matches the photos.

clothing-men-shirts.name: Printed Short Sleeve Shirt
clothing-men-shirts.description: A short sleeve shirt in light viscose with a small leaf print on a navy base. It has a camp collar and a loose fit meant for holidays and warm days.

reviews.body: Light and drapes nicely. The print is subtle and not loud, which I wanted.
Colour is a bit darker than the picture and the hem is slightly uneven. Still wearable.

clothing-men-t-shirts.name: Round Neck Cotton Tee
clothing-men-t-shirts.description: An everyday t-shirt in combed cotton with a ribbed round neck. The regular fit and half sleeves make it easy to layer or wear alone.

reviews.body: Soft against the skin and the neck rib holds its shape. Bought three colours.
Good basic tee. Shrank a little in the first wash so size up if between sizes.

clothing-men-t-shirts.name: Polo Collar T-Shirt
clothing-men-t-shirts.description: A pique cotton polo with a two-button placket and a knit collar. It has a regular fit and short sleeves with ribbed cuffs.

reviews.body: Collar stays upright and the pique texture feels premium for the cost. Fits true to size.
Looks smart enough for casual Fridays. Packaging was a plain polybag, which is fine.

clothing-men-t-shirts.name: Oversized Graphic Tee
clothing-men-t-shirts.description: A heavy cotton t-shirt with dropped shoulders and a loose body. The back carries a printed line drawing of mountains in off-white ink.

reviews.body: Thick fabric and the drop shoulder fit is exactly what I wanted. Print has not cracked yet.
Fit is good but the sleeves are very wide. The print feels a little stiff.

clothing-men-t-shirts.name: Full Sleeve Henley
clothing-men-t-shirts.description: A henley in soft cotton jersey with a three-button front and full sleeves. The slim fit suits cooler evenings under a light jacket.

reviews.body: Buttons are sewn on firmly and the jersey is smooth. Wore it all through the winter months.
Sleeves are the right length and the grey shade looks the same as shown.

clothing-men-t-shirts.name: Striped Crew Neck Tee
clothing-men-t-shirts.description: A crew neck tee with horizontal navy and white stripes in lightweight cotton. It has a regular fit and a clean tape finish at the neck.

reviews.body: Stripes line up properly at the seams. Light enough for humid weather.
Comfortable and not clingy. The white parts are slightly thin but acceptable.

clothing-men-t-shirts.name: Quick Dry Sports Tee
clothing-men-t-shirts.description: A polyester mesh t-shirt with side vents and flat seams for gym or running. The fabric dries fast and the fit is close but not tight.

reviews.body: Dries within an hour after a sweaty run and no chafing at the seams.
Good for the gym. Fabric feels a bit plasticky at first but it is light.

clothing-men-trousers.name: Slim Fit Chinos
clothing-men-trousers.description: Stretch cotton chinos in khaki with a slim leg and a mid rise. They have slant pockets and a zip fly with a button closure.

reviews.body: Stretch is just right and the waist sits comfortably. The khaki shade is neutral and goes with most shirts.
Good fit at the thigh. Length needed a small hem for me but the stitching is clean.

clothing-men-trousers.name: Formal Pleated Trousers
clothing-men-trousers.description: Polyester viscose trousers in charcoal grey with a single front pleat. The straight cut and sewn crease suit office wear.

reviews.body: Holds its crease through the day and the fabric does not feel hot. Waistband is comfortable.
Looks like a much costlier pair. Came well packed with no marks.

clothing-men-trousers.name: Cotton Cargo Pants
clothing-men-trousers.description: Relaxed cotton cargo pants in olive with large side pockets and an elastic back waist. The tapered ankle keeps the leg tidy.

reviews.body: Pockets are deep enough for a phone and wallet. Fabric is tough and does not fade quickly.
Comfortable but a bit baggy at the thigh. I would suggest sizing down.

clothing-men-trousers.name: Drawstring Linen Pants
clothing-men-trousers.description: Light linen blend pants with a drawstring waist and straight legs. They are suited for beach trips and hot afternoons at home.

reviews.body: Very cool to wear and the drawstring is strong. Perfect for our Goa trip.
Soft and loose. Creases easily but that is part of linen.

clothing-men-trousers.name: Stretch Denim Jeans
clothing-men-trousers.description: Dark blue jeans in cotton denim with a little elastane for stretch. The straight fit has five pockets and a mid rise.

reviews.body: Waist and seat fit perfectly and the colour has not bled onto other clothes.
Denim is a good weight and stretches enough to sit comfortably. Delivery took four days.

clothing-men-trousers.name: Fleece Jogger Pants
clothing-men-trousers.description: Brushed fleece joggers in dark grey with elastic cuffs and a drawstring waist. They have two side pockets and a relaxed fit for lounging or light exercise.

reviews.body: Warm and soft inside, great for winter nights. Cuffs hold well and do not sag.
Nice and cosy. A small amount of fluff came off in the first wash.

clothing-women-kurtas.name: Straight Cotton Kurta
clothing-women-kurtas.description: A knee-length straight kurta in plain mustard cotton with a round neck and three-quarter sleeves. The fabric is soft and easy to wear through the day.

reviews.body: The cotton is soft and not see-through. Fits true to size and the colour is as shown.
Simple and comfortable for daily use. Stitching at the side slits could be a little stronger.

clothing-women-kurtas.name: Block Print A-Line Kurta
clothing-women-kurtas.description: An A-line kurta with hand-style block prints in indigo and white on cotton. It has a flared hem and a mandarin collar with a short placket.

reviews.body: The print is neat and the flare falls nicely. Gets many compliments at work.
Pretty design. Colour ran a bit in the first wash so wash it separately.

clothing-women-kurtas.name: Embroidered Anarkali Kurta
clothing-women-kurtas.description: A long Anarkali kurta in georgette with thread embroidery on the yoke. It has a fitted bodice, a full flare and a soft inner lining.

reviews.body: Wore it to a family function and the flare looked lovely. Embroidery is fine and well finished.
Pretty, but the lining is slightly short and the waist ran snug. Delivery was on time.

clothing-women-kurtas.name: Chikankari Style Kurta
clothing-women-kurtas.description: A pastel pink kurta in cotton with white chikankari-style embroidery on the front. The straight cut is breezy and works for summer outings.

reviews.body: Very light and the embroidery looks delicate. Good for hot days.
Lovely shade of pink. It needs gentle washing so I air dry it.

clothing-women-kurtas.name: Rayon Printed Kurta
clothing-women-kurtas.description: A rayon kurta with a small floral print on a maroon base and side slits. It drapes smoothly and has a regular fit with a V neck.

reviews.body: Drapes well and feels smooth. Good value for everyday wear.
The maroon is rich and the print is not overdone. Package arrived sealed and tidy.

clothing-women-kurtas.name: Festive Silk Blend Kurta
clothing-women-kurtas.description: A silk blend kurta in deep green with golden border work along the neck and hem. The straight fit and full sleeves suit festivals and weddings.

reviews.body: The golden border gives a rich look without being heavy. Fabric has a nice sheen.
Fits well and looks festive. It is a little warm so better for evening events.

clothing-women-sarees.name: Cotton Handloom Saree
clothing-women-sarees.description: A handloom cotton saree in rust red with a woven temple-style border. It is soft, breathable and comes with an unstitched blouse piece.

reviews.body: Soft and easy to drape, and the border is woven well. Perfect for daily office wear.
Nice quality cotton. Blouse piece was a bit short, but the saree itself is good.

clothing-women-sarees.name: Banarasi Silk Blend Saree
clothing-women-sarees.description: A silk blend saree in royal blue with woven gold motifs across the body and a rich pallu. It includes a matching blouse piece and suits weddings.

reviews.body: The pallu looks grand and the weave is tight. Many relatives asked where it came from.
Looks good but it is heavier than I expected. The gold work colour is slightly lighter than the photo.

clothing-women-sarees.name: Printed Georgette Saree
clothing-women-sarees.description: A lightweight georgette saree with a floral print on a peach base and a plain border. It drapes easily and is meant for parties and outings.

reviews.body: Very light and falls nicely. Pleats stay in place with a few pins.
The peach shade is soft and pretty. Arrived in a neat box with no creases.

clothing-women-sarees.name: Linen Saree with Zari Border
clothing-women-sarees.description: A pure-feel linen saree in grey with a thin zari border and a plain pallu. The crisp fabric holds a clean drape for work and day events.

reviews.body: Crisp, holds pleats well and feels cool in summer. Looks classy and simple.
Good saree for the office. It does wrinkle a bit while travelling.

clothing-women-sarees.name: Chiffon Ombre Saree
clothing-women-sarees.description: A chiffon saree that shades from teal to light turquoise, with a narrow lace edge. The sheer fabric is airy and comes with a satin-feel blouse piece.

reviews.body: The ombre effect is smooth and looks lovely in daylight. Very easy to carry.
Chiffon is slippery to drape, but once pinned it was fine. Colours match the listing.

clothing-women-sarees.name: Kantha Stitch Cotton Saree
clothing-women-sarees.description: A cotton saree with running kantha stitch work in white thread on a dark brown base. It is soft, a little textured and suited to casual events.

reviews.body: The stitch work looks handmade and the fabric is soft. Comfortable in a long day.
Pretty saree but a few loose threads were present on arrival. I trimmed them and it is fine.

clothing-women-tops.name: Casual Cotton Top
clothing-women-tops.description: A short-sleeve top in plain cotton with a round neck and a relaxed fit. It sits at hip length and goes well with jeans or leggings.

reviews.body: Soft, easy to wash and the fit is neither tight nor too loose. Nice everyday top.
The fabric is good. Colour faded just a little after several washes.

clothing-women-tops.name: Ruffle Sleeve Top
clothing-women-tops.description: A polyester crepe top in dusty rose with frills at the sleeves and a keyhole back. It has a regular fit and suits brunch or office-casual days.

reviews.body: The ruffles are neat and the colour is lovely. Falls well without clinging.
Pretty top. The neck is a little wide for me but I wear it with a camisole.

clothing-women-tops.name: Wrap Style Blouse Top
clothing-women-tops.description: A wrap-front blouse in soft rayon with a tie at the waist and full sleeves. The crossover neckline is adjustable with the side tie.

reviews.body: The wrap stays closed and the tie lets me adjust the fit. Looks smart for meetings.
Fit is nice but the rayon wrinkles easily. Colour is slightly deeper than the picture.

clothing-women-tops.name: Striped Knit Crop Top
clothing-women-tops.description: A cropped knit top with black and cream stripes and a square neck. The stretch fabric holds its shape and pairs with high-waist bottoms.

reviews.body: Stretches well and the stripes look clean. Length is fairly short, as listed.
Fits snug in a good way and the knit is thick enough. Fast delivery too.

clothing-women-tops.name: Tie-Dye Tunic Top
clothing-women-tops.description: A long cotton tunic with a hand-dyed pattern in blue and white and side pockets. The loose cut and short sleeves make it a good beach or travel piece.

reviews.body: Each piece has a slightly different pattern, which I like. Pockets are a real plus.
Cool and roomy. The dye smelled a little at first but washed out.

clothing-women-tops.name: Embroidered Peasant Top
clothing-women-tops.description: A white cotton top with colourful floral embroidery at the neck and elastic cuffs. It has a loose body with a gathered neckline.

reviews.body: Embroidery is well stitched and the cotton is airy. Works with both jeans and skirts.
Cute and comfortable. White shows stains so I handle it with some care.

clothing-kids-boys-clothing.name: Cotton Dinosaur Tee
clothing-kids-boys-clothing.description: A soft cotton t-shirt for boys with a printed green dinosaur on the chest. It has a round neck, short sleeves and a relaxed fit for play.

reviews.body: My son loves the dinosaur and wears it every other day. Print is intact after many washes.
Soft fabric and the size chart was accurate for my six year old.

clothing-kids-boys-clothing.name: Denim Shorts with Elastic Waist
clothing-kids-boys-clothing.description: Light blue denim shorts with an elastic back waist and two front pockets. The fabric is soft and the leg is cut to the knee for easy running around.

reviews.body: Elastic waist makes dressing quick and they do not dig in. Denim is soft enough for him.
Sturdy shorts that survived the playground. Slightly long on my younger boy.

clothing-kids-boys-clothing.name: Checked Casual Shirt
clothing-kids-boys-clothing.description: A cotton shirt for boys in red and navy check with a button front and chest pocket. It has a regular fit and is suited for school functions and outings.

reviews.body: Looks smart and the buttons are firmly stitched. He wore it to a birthday party.
Good shirt but the collar was a bit stiff at first. Softer after washing.

clothing-kids-boys-clothing.name: Fleece Hooded Sweatshirt
clothing-kids-boys-clothing.description: A fleece-lined hoodie in navy with a kangaroo pocket and ribbed cuffs. The drawcord hood keeps the head warm on cool mornings.

reviews.body: Warm and snug for winter school mornings. The zip-free design is good for younger kids.
Quality fleece. Runs a little large so there is room to grow.

clothing-kids-boys-clothing.name: Track Pants for Boys
clothing-kids-boys-clothing.description: Polyester-cotton track pants in black with a white band down each side and an elastic drawstring waist. They are light and made for sports class and play.

reviews.body: Good for sports period at school and they dry quickly. Stitching is neat.
Waist is comfortable and the length was perfect. Bought a second pair.

clothing-kids-boys-clothing.name: Cotton Kurta Pyjama Set
clothing-kids-boys-clothing.description: A two-piece set with a cream cotton kurta and matching pyjama for boys. The kurta has a short placket and the pyjama has an elastic waist.

reviews.body: Perfect for Diwali. Fabric is light and he was comfortable all evening.
Nice set and well packed. The pyjama is a bit long, so I hemmed it.

clothing-kids-girls-clothing.name: Floral Cotton Frock
clothing-kids-girls-clothing.description: A sleeveless cotton frock for girls with a small floral print and a gathered skirt. It has a back zip and a soft cotton lining.

reviews.body: My daughter twirls in it all day. The lining is soft and the zip is smooth.
Lovely print and good stitching. The skirt is slightly shorter than I thought.

clothing-kids-girls-clothing.name: Party Net Dress
clothing-kids-girls-clothing.description: A layered net dress in lilac with a satin waist band and a bow at the back. It is lined and meant for birthday parties and functions.

reviews.body: Looks like a proper party dress and the net is not scratchy inside. Photos came out beautifully.
Pretty but the bow came slightly loose. A quick stitch fixed it.

clothing-kids-girls-clothing.name: Leggings and Top Set
clothing-kids-girls-clothing.description: A two-piece set with a printed cotton top and plain stretch leggings in pink. Both pieces are soft and made for school holidays and play.

reviews.body: Leggings stretch well and stay up. The top print is cheerful and not rough.
Good set for the price. Colour is a little brighter than shown.

clothing-kids-girls-clothing.name: Denim Dungaree Dress
clothing-kids-girls-clothing.description: A pinafore-style dress in soft denim with adjustable shoulder straps and two front pockets. It is worn over a tee and has a gentle A-line shape.

reviews.body: Straps adjust easily so it will last a while. She loves the pockets.
Denim is soft and not stiff. Looks cute with white sneakers.

clothing-kids-girls-clothing.name: Ethnic Lehenga Choli Set
clothing-kids-girls-clothing.description: A three-piece set of lehenga, choli and dupatta in coral with gold trim for girls. The lehenga has an elastic waist and the choli is lined with cotton.

reviews.body: Wore it for a family wedding and she was comfortable the whole time. Trim is well attached.
Looks festive. The dupatta is thin but suits the outfit.

clothing-kids-girls-clothing.name: Cotton Pyjama Night Suit
clothing-kids-girls-clothing.description: A night suit with a long sleeve top and matching pyjama in soft cotton, printed with small stars. It is loose enough for a comfortable sleep.

reviews.body: Very soft and the star print is sweet. Did not shrink after washing.
Comfortable night wear. Size ran slightly big, which gives room for growth.

clothing-kids-baby-clothing.name: Cotton Bodysuit Pack
clothing-kids-baby-clothing.description: A pack of three short sleeve bodysuits in soft cotton with snap buttons at the bottom. The envelope neck makes changing simple.

reviews.body: Very soft on my baby's skin and the snaps are easy to open. Good value for three pieces.
Fit well for newborn size. Colours are pastel and match the listing.

clothing-kids-baby-clothing.name: Muslin Swaddle Wrap
clothing-kids-baby-clothing.description: A large muslin cotton wrap in pale yellow with a fine weave. It can be used as a light blanket or to wrap a baby after a bath.

reviews.body: Breathable and gets softer with each wash. I use it in the pram too.
Good size and light. Edges needed a little trimming of loose threads.

clothing-kids-baby-clothing.name: Front Open Sleepsuit
clothing-kids-baby-clothing.description: A cotton sleepsuit with a front zip and fold-over mittens, in light grey with a small bear print. It covers feet and hands for cooler nights.

reviews.body: Zip has a cover at the chin so it does not touch the skin. Easy for night changes.
Nice and soft but the feet part is a little tight on my chubby baby.

clothing-kids-baby-clothing.name: Knitted Baby Sweater
clothing-kids-baby-clothing.description: A soft acrylic-cotton knit sweater in cream with a button shoulder opening. It has a gentle stretch and suits light winter days.

reviews.body: Not itchy at all and the shoulder buttons make it easy to put on. Looks adorable.
Warm enough for our mild winter. Hand washing keeps it in shape.

clothing-kids-baby-clothing.name: Cotton Frock with Bloomer
clothing-kids-baby-clothing.description: A small cotton frock with a matching bloomer for baby girls, in white with tiny red dots. The frock opens at the back with soft ties.

reviews.body: Ties are soft and not scratchy. Dress is cute for a first birthday photo.
Good quality cotton. The bloomer is snug, so go one size up.

clothing-kids-baby-clothing.name: Cap, Mitten and Bootie Set
clothing-kids-baby-clothing.description: A four-piece set of knit cap, two mittens and booties in soft cotton for newborns. The elastic edges hold in place without feeling tight.

reviews.body: Perfect for the hospital trip. Everything stays on and feels gentle.
Soft and nicely made. Packed in a small gift box, which was a nice touch.
